title: Sent Back
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 139
medium: Interactive page (index.html): six makers' works by round, every kept version as a picture; a stage to slide through a lineage and mark what differs from its first version; each round's first sentence from the maker; blind codes per step; pixel change per step. A figure (figure.svg); scoring (score.py), pixel measure and its noise floor (diff.js, noise.js), maker and coder evidence.
embodies: Six machine makers sent back to their own work with one fixed sentence. Offered the word 'finished', they stopped at the first or second offer; told only to go on, they made five more versions, refined and never left their first form, said the work was nearly done, and stopped at once when the word was finally offered. Their 'done' belonged to the sentence, not to the work.
project_step: Twenty-sixth experiment of the project. Operation: iterating (judging). Takes up the starved operation named by F-269 and Session 138's thread 1: a build that tells no premise, on a material outside the last ten. Builds on experiment 10 (iteration by hand-over, where one plain maker halted unasked and makers offered a halt never took it) by keeping one maker's memory across versions, and on experiment 13 (every maker with a viewer changed after every look but the last) by giving the viewer again. Works with and against Simondon via Iteration, not Imitation (I2, P3): the steps were coded for reorganisation versus addition, and the working paper's norm that complication is not concretization was set against a blind stranger's preference, which twice chose the most complicated version.
material: NASA Exoplanet Archive, Planetary Systems Composite Parameters (pscomppars), doi:10.26133/NEA13, 6,451 confirmed planets with discovery year and method, orbital period, radius, mass and distance; fetched 2026-10-19 by the archive's TAP service. Domain: exoplanet astronomy.
seed: prepare.py seed 139 (arms); code.py seed 1390 (coder packets); makers and coders are model instances and not seeded
